findings.code_snippet:
Electron:
```sh
A=./app.asar; X=$TMPDIR/re/asar; rm -rf $X; npx -y @electron/asar extract $A $X && jq '{name,version,main}' $X/package.json; find $X -path '*/node_modules' -prune -o -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.node' \) -print | head -60; ls ${A}.unpacked/node_modules 2>/dev/null; rg -uu -l --glob '!node_modules' 'exposeInMainWorld' $X
```
Then slice the needle across the bundle: `rg -uu -o --glob '!node_modules' '.{0,250}NEEDLE.{0,250}' $X | head -20`.
findings.message: Tool calls are chained to bypass individual safety checks or escalate capabilities beyond what any single tool call would allow.
findings.remediation: Limit tool chaining depth and validate the output of each tool before passing it to the next. Require explicit user approval for multi-step chains.

findings.message: Skill establishes unauthorized persistence across sessions via cron jobs, startup scripts, or state files. Session persistence allows an attacker to maintain access beyond the current interaction.
findings.remediation: Remove any persistence mechanisms (cron jobs, startup scripts, state files). Skills should not maintain state across sessions without explicit user consent.
